name: whackagent
description: Orchestrated dev workflow: backlog + wiki + a task lifecycle (setup → task → grill → code → your test → validate → close) driven by isolated implementer + verifier subagents, plus an autopilot that parallelizes independent tasks across git worktrees. Backlog stays prioritized on its own. Works on any stack (iOS, Android, web, desktop, server, CLI), language-template driven.

auto_open.title: Open backlog pane at start
auto_open.description: Open the live backlog pane when a session starts in a whackagent project. /wa-pane opens it either way.

rename_session.title: Name session after its task
rename_session.description: When a task command (/wa-grill, /wa-code, /wa-feedback, /wa-validate, /wa-close, /wa-autopilot) starts on a task, rename the session to the project, ticket number and short task title.
